title: CLAUDE.md — operating instructions for the aurora package
text: Decided deliberately (see dev/DECISIONS.md). change one, write new ADR. plumber2 . plumber v1 path. Use api(), api_parse(), api_assets()/api_statics(), api_run(), api_auth_guard(). Thin JS runtime. inst/runtime/core.js stays minimal (credentialed fetch wrapper exposing window.aurora, + onUnauthorized). Rendering orchestration live app’s www/js/app.js feature JS, aurora. Pluggable auth. Never aurora_app()’s core path. aurora_auth_jwt() one optional scheme meant wrap plumber2’s native guards. Path comes annotation. handler’s URL #* @get /... value. aurora_add_route() embeds mount scaffold time; aurora_app() runtime path injection. UI static. aurora_build_ui() sources build_ui.R, calls build_ui(), writes HTML via htmltools::save_html(). reactive server. Convention manifest. aurora_app() assembles fixed layout (parse routers/*.R, source helpers/*.R, serve www/). Theming via brand.yml. Theming _brand.yml file consumed natively bslib (bs_theme(version = 5, brand = TRUE)), resolved build time. aurora recognises file convention never builds theming layer. _brand.yml orthogonal _aurora.yml (visual identity vs app wiring); add brand key _aurora.yml (see ADR-011).

title: CLAUDE.md — operating instructions for the aurora package
text: Naming: exported functions snake_case aurora_ prefix. Internal helpers snake_case, unexported, prefix. Logging: everything user-facing cli (cli_alert_*, cli_abort, cli_warn) inline markup ({.path }, {.fn }, {.val }, {.url }). message/warning/stop/print/cat new code. Style: tidyverse; native pipe |>; fs path/file ops; internal %||% (R/aurora-package.R). Docs: every exported function gets complete roxygen block (@param, @return, @export) + test inst/examples/ app. Roxygen markdown . Errors: validate early cli_abort() actionable = hint.

title: CLAUDE.md — operating instructions for the aurora package
text: R/app-config.R — convention + optional manifest (read_config, router_files, helper_files, assert_is_app, resolve_otel). layout contract lives . R/app.R — aurora_app(): convention → plumber2 api(). heart. R/build-ui.R — aurora_build_ui() (runs build_ui() cwd = app dir bslib finds _brand.yml). R/run.R — aurora_run() (+ watch, otel). R/create-app.R, R/add-route.R, R/dockerfile.R, R/build-image.R, R/shinyproxy.R (aurora_shinyproxy_yaml()). R/auth.R — JWT-cookie scheme, WIRED: aurora_auth_jwt() + aurora_jwt_token/ decode/guard, aurora_set/clear_auth_cookie (jose + reqres; ADR-010). R/component.R — aurora_component() (thin UI↔︎API helper; ADR-009). R/data-store.R — aurora_data_store() + _register/_get/_names (hot-reload). R/watch.R — live-reload internals aurora_run(watch = TRUE). inst/runtime/core.js — shipped runtime (keep thin; copied www/js/core.js). inst/templates/{minimal,auth}/ — scaffolding templates (canonical layout). inst/examples/{01-hello,02-dashboard-echarts,03-map}/ — runnable worked apps. tests/testthat/ — tests. New exported function ⇒ new tests. vignettes/ (aurora, migrating--shiny, auth, telemetry, deploy + articles/gallery), _pkgdown.yml — site (builds clean). dev/ — project memory (Rbuildignored): STATE, PLAN, ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS, LESSONS, PLUMBER2-NOTES, MIGRATION-V1-V2, BACKLOG. Update work.

title: CLAUDE.md — operating instructions for the aurora package
text: Query params bind named handler args plumber2 — path <var> . Read query via query arg, body via body; req/res reqres request/response. (Full v1→v2 map: dev/MIGRATION-V1-V2.md.) @header/@/api/* guard must return plumber2::Next — namespaced, plumber2 isn’t attached aurora’s assembly (bare Next → 500). reqres set_cookie(same_site=) wants "Lax"/"Strict"/"None" (capitalised); cookies live outside $headers serialised (use res$as_list() tests). \uXXXX escapes work R string literals roxygen #' text — leak .Rd unknown \u macro (WARNING). Use ASCII roxygen. bs_theme(brand = TRUE) needs brand.yml pkg discovers _brand.yml relative cwd; aurora_build_ui() sets cwd app dir build. htmltools::HTML() takes ONE string — paste(..., sep="\n") first. \\+newline continuation inside cli strings (renders literal \). fs::dir_copy(src, dst) nests dst pre-exists; delete dst first. fs::path(".", "/abs") collapse — use fs::path_abs(p, start=dir). Helpers sys.source()d global env router handlers can see ; prefer <<-/globals inside helpers. plumber2 default port 8080, docs /__docs__; aurora defaults 8000. Test routes without server: pa$test_request(fiery::fake_request(...)) (content must character string, default "").

title: CLAUDE.md — operating instructions for the aurora package

title: Authentication
text: Three pieces, app — aurora_app() needs auth knowledge: 1. scheme (helper). helpers/auth_setup.R defines scheme user lookup: 2. gate (header route). routers/guard.R runs every /api/* handler — request body even received — rejecting anyone without valid token clean 401: 3. Public login/logout (/api, gate ignores ).
code: auth <- aurora_auth_jwt(secret = Sys.getenv("AURORA_JWT_SECRET", "dev-only")) secure_cookies <- identical(Sys.getenv("AURORA_ENV"), "prod") find_user <- function(name) ...   # your DB / store; passwords hashed with sodium #* @any /api/* #* @header function(request) {   aurora_jwt_guard(auth, request)   # 401 via reqres::abort_unauthorized() if invalid   plumber2::Next                    # otherwise continue the chain } #* @post /auth/login #* @parser json #* @serializer json function(request, response, body = NULL) {   u <- find_user(body$user)   if (is.null(u) || !sodium::password_verify(u$hash, body$pass %||% "")) {     response$status <- 401L     return(list(error = "Usuario ou senha invalidos."))   }   token <- aurora_jwt_token(auth, list(user = u$name))   aurora_set_auth_cookie(auth, response, token, secure = secure_cookies)   list(user = u$name) }  #* @post /auth/logout #* @serializer json function(response) {   aurora_clear_auth_cookie(auth, response, secure = secure_cookies)   list(status = "ok") }

title: Authentication
text: cookie HttpOnly, JavaScript never touches token. app.js simply probes GET /api/load (reveal app success), posts /auth/login / /auth/logout, shows login overlay whenever /api call returns 401 via runtime’s aurora.onUnauthorized hook.

title: Authentication
text: plumber2’s native api_auth_guard() + fireproof guards target upstream identity providers (OAuth/OIDC) shared static keys, require firesale datastore plugin, return 400/403. self-issued JWT-cookie session needs uniform 401 absent expired sessions (cookie expiry looks like “absent”) extra infrastructure — aurora uses @header guard + reqres::abort_unauthorized(), migration-endorsed replacement v1 filters. (See ADRs package’s dev/DECISIONS.md.)

title: Authentication
text: Set strong AURORA_JWT_SECRET (never commit ). Set AURORA_ENV=prod behind HTTPS Secure; SameSite=Strict cookies. Replace demo find_user() real, sodium-hashed user store.

title: Deploying aurora apps
text: static UI compiled build time shipped www/index.html; container serves rebuild , runtime image installs UI dependencies (bslib, transitively shiny). Build UI image: generated Dockerfile pulls R packages prebuilt binaries Posit Package Manager, builds fast need compiler toolchain run time. Posit Package Manager serves amd64 (x86_64) Linux binaries, Apple Silicon machine build production target explicitly — otherwise native arm64 build compiles every dependency source: aurora_dockerfile() writes Dockerfile whose entry point Rscript api.R, container local development share one assembly path. Key arguments: flavor — "debian" (default) "alpine" (see ). base — base image; NULL resolves per flavor (rocker/r-ver / rhub/r-minimal). sysdeps — "auto" uses curated default set covering plumber2 + bslib baseline plus common TLS/curl/db/geo/graphics needs; pass vector override. port — exposed port (default 8000).
code: library(aurora)  aurora_build_ui("meu_app")   # compile www/index.html (needs bslib; run on dev/CI)  # Generate a Dockerfile (+ .dockerignore). It installs only the runtime deps # your routers/helpers need, plus plumber2 and aurora. aurora_dockerfile("meu_app")  # Build (and optionally push) the image using the docker CLI. aurora_build_image("meu_app", tag = "org/meu_app:latest", push = TRUE) docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t org/meu_app:latest .

title: Deploying aurora apps
text: alpine flavor compiles everything (CRAN binaries Alpine) uses installr -d -t "<build deps>" -"<runtime libs>". aurora ships defaults cover plumber2 + bslib baseline; extra system libraries (e.g. GDAL/GEOS sf) pass via sysdeps. Note aurora’s baseline still pulls non-trivial tree (httpuv, fiery stack, roxygen2, graphics packages), even small app compiles fair amount Alpine — win final image size.
code: aurora_dockerfile("meu_app", flavor = "alpine")

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: instrumentation lives layers plumber2 (reqres, fiery, routr), works moment OpenTelemetry enabled environment: span per request, attached request object (request$otel) closed automatically response sent. carries standard HTTP attributes plus server.id, server.framework.name ("plumber2"), server.framework.version. subspan per route request passes , routr.route routr.path.param.<name> attributes. standard server metrics: http.server.request.duration, http.server.active_requests, http.server.request.body.size, http.server.response.body.size.

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: aurora wires plumber2::api_logger(plumber2::logger_otel()) logs join spans metrics. Enable three ways (highest precedence first): flag resolves : explicit otel = argument > _aurora.yml otel: > AURORA_OTEL env var > FALSE (). Leaving safe: wiring otel logger -op OpenTelemetry actually enabled environment (see ). can bake otel: true production image control collection purely env vars.
code: # 1. Explicitly at run time aurora_run("meu_app", otel = TRUE)  # 2. In the optional manifest — _aurora.yml # otel: true  # 3. Via environment (handy for containers; the generated api.R reads it) Sys.setenv(AURORA_OTEL = "true") aurora_run("meu_app")

title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: aurora exporter configuration — belongs otel otelsdk packages, driven standard OTEL_* environment variables. essentials: Install otel (instrumentation API) otelsdk (collector/exporter). Select exporters OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER (OTEL_R_* variants). none set, nothing emitted — exactly makes aurora flag safe -op. Use OTEL_ENV=dev developing telemetry code fails loudly instead swallowing errors. Consult otel/otelsdk package docs full list pointing exporter collector (e.g. OTLP endpoint). aurora intentionally wrap .

what: Custom spans and logs in your handlers
title: Telemetry with OpenTelemetry
text: Inside route handler can add spans; automatically pick active routr subspan parent: Two aurora conventions worth following: Log server$log(...) (reserved server handler argument) rather cat()/print(), logs picked otel logger associated request span. Keep custom instrumentation sparse — default instrumentation already detailed. Add spans operations specifically care .
code: #* @get /api/report/<id> #* @serializer json function(id, server) {   otel::start_local_active_span("build report")   # closes at end of scope   server$log("message", paste("building report", id))   # joins the request span   build_report(id) }

title: JWT-cookie authentication scheme — aurora_auth_jwt
text: companion helpers operate scheme object: aurora_jwt_token() mints signed token (login). aurora_set_auth_cookie() / aurora_clear_auth_cookie() manage cookie. aurora_jwt_guard() gate: call @header handler /api/* rejects unauthenticated requests 401. title: Generate a Dockerfile (and .dockerignore) for an aurora app — aurora_dockerfile
text: dir App directory. flavor Base-image flavor: "debian" (rocker + PPM binaries) "alpine" (r-minimal + source builds). base Base Docker image. NULL (default) resolves per flavor: rocker/r-ver:4.4.1 (debian) rhub/r-minimal (alpine). sysdeps "auto" uses curated default set system packages flavor (covers plumber2 + bslib baseline plus common TLS/curl/db/geo/ graphics needs); pass character vector set explicitly. "alpine" build (-t) set; runtime libs use curated default. (pkg_sysreqs() auto-resolution proved unreliable, aurora ships comprehensive defaults instead — extra -dev packages build-time .) port Port exposed bound (via AURORA_PORT env var). aurora_source pak/remotes spec used install aurora image. write Write file (TRUE) return text (FALSE).

title: Generate a Dockerfile (and .dockerignore) for an aurora app — aurora_dockerfile
text: Two flavors: "debian" (default) — rocker/r-ver; installs R packages binaries Posit Package Manager (fast builds; amd64). Best heavy/geo apps fast CI. Larger image. "alpine" — rhub/r-minimal; tiny image (~25 MB base) compiles every package source via installr (CRAN binaries; builds slower). Best image size matters need native arm64. Tune Alpine build/runtime system deps via sysdeps packages need .
